'''Ostar-Gal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the ensuing [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]], Ostar-Gal was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. A noted [[Jedi Consular|Consular]] and [[Lore Keeper]], Master Ostar-Gal was the [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]] of the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] which were maintained in the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Tython. He was a friend of Master [[Yuon Par]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Before its removal from the game, Master Ostar-Gal introduced the mission "Advanced Training: Jedi Consular" for Jedi Consular players who had just completed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he directed players to their Advanced Class trainer, Master [[Dynaroth]]. Ostar-Gal could be found both on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] and on [[Carrick Station]]. According to the game's conversation files, Ostar-Gal was originally [[Gnost-Dural]], a character who appeared in the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'' videos.<ref name="TOR" />
